title: Blog
description: Blog post entry with content, author information, tags, and engagement metrics. Used for personal blogs, company blogs, and content management systems.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post

title.description: Title or headline of the blog post

author.description: Full name of the blog post author

content.description: Full blog post content and body text

tags.description: Array of topic tags for categorization

views.description: Total number of page views for this blog post

published_at.description: Timestamp when the blog post was published
